note: det_v0 with per-outcome intercepts re-set to logit(observed base rate) from the M4 retrospective backfill (checkpoint 8.3). Weight directions are unchanged. Only cells with a trustworthy observed rate get a `biasOverride`; every other cell keeps its det_v0 hand-set prior and is labelled 'not measured' in `provenance`. When feature coverage is poor (>70% of features null) the caller emits the base rate at confidence:low rather than this logistic. det_v0.2 (the full re-featured 14-day backfill) will re-derive every cell.

DRAWDOWN_80@24h.note: likely a floor — the deadest tokens have no price series and drop out of the denominator

TRADING_ALIVE@24h.note: positive polarity: rate = P(still trading). ~73% of qualified launches stop trading by 24h

notMeasured.INSIDER_EXIT@72h: 0 resolved (few qualified launches >= 72h old in the 14d window)
notMeasured.SELL_IMPAIRED@1h: resolver+pool contamination: ~95% true with 112 unresolvable. Wrong-pool launches quote garbage; clean measurement needs the live pipeline or the full re-featured backfill. Keep det_v0 prior.
